description: The 2015 fight between Terrel Williams and Prichard Colon ended in a way few expected. Years later, the bout remains one of boxing’s most painful stories, with questions still surrounding what happened afterward. Colon’s death has now brought the fight back into focus, while Williams’ own path after that night has remained largely outside public view. For many fans today.
title: Where is Terrel Williams now after Prichard Colon fight? What happened to his career

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Denise Dresser, OpenAI’s Chief Revenue Officer, is resigning after a short tenure. This follows a pattern of notable departures within the organization. In her place, Dali Rajic, who previously worked at Wiz, will step in as the new Chief Revenue Officer. As OpenAI gears up for its potential initial public offering, it has also filed its IPO prospectus with the SEC in secrecy.
title: OpenAI loses another top executive as CRO Denise Dresser resigns

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In 1970, the Blackwell family’s nearly 600-acre Missouri farm was acquired through eminent domain during the creation of Ozark National Scenic Riverways. The government initially offered $73,000, but after a federal court battle, the family received $214,000. Darrel Blackwell later became a park ranger and longtime canoe rental concessioner.
title: Missouri family wins $214k for 600 acres in 1970 park eminent domain fight
